title: Corner Panels as Direct Tab Button Groups
description:
Turn the corner panels into button groups where the tabs are directly shown. When clicked on a tab, expand it. Remove the general panel fold/unfold toggles.

Implementation: removed CornerPanelChrome (the generic Toggle button used to fold/unfold each corner panel) from ui/js/react/index.tsx's CornerPanel component. The PanelTabBar (button group of tabs) is now always rendered, even when the panel is folded — a new `rootRowOnly` prop keeps only the top-level row visible while folded so nested branch children don't clutter the collapsed state. Clicking a tab now both selects it and opens the panel if folded; clicking the already-active tab while open folds the panel back up. Also removed the now-dead corner-chrome drag-and-drop drop target (registerCornerChromeDropTarget, chromeRects) since row-level drop targets already cover append-at-end and corners with zero tabs are never mounted anyway. Updated/removed the corresponding tests in ui/js/react/index.tsx (CornerPanel toggle-chrome tests, computeTabDockDropZone chrome-rect test, corner panel toggle i18n key test).
summary: Fixed two regressions from the initial corner-panel button-group change: (1) the tab strip's divider border was hardcoded to border-bottom regardless of corner; split panelTabBarClass into a border-less base plus a new direction-aware cornerPanelTabBarClass(direction) function, threaded a `direction` prop from PanelTabBar through PanelTabRow, so bottom corners now get border-top (divider on the content-facing side, matching the panel's true stacking geometry) while top corners keep border-bottom. (2) The active tab's bg-active-base/border/text-emphasized fill was rendering even while the panel was folded; added a `showActiveColor` prop (PanelTabBar → PanelTabRow) that CornerPanel sets to its own `visible` state, so the fill only paints when the panel is actually expanded. Extended the existing CornerPanel test block with coverage for both fixes. Verified via renderToStaticMarkup dumps (confirmed border-b for top corners / border-t for bottom corners, and bg-active-base only present when visible) and the full CornerPanel/PanelTabBar test suite (all passing); typecheck shows no new errors.
